questions.question: How much does Cobalt get paid when UAT is complete?
questions.reference_answer: $1,200,000 (25% of the fixed price), payment milestone PM-3, tied to M5 UAT complete.

questions.question: What is the mitigation for RSK-014?
questions.reference_answer: Weekly executive call with DataBridge (Kevin Walsh); service credits under SOW section 9.3; parallel evaluation of Azure Data Factory as a fallback, with a go/no-go on the fallback by 2026-04-24.

evidence.text: Weekly executive call with DataBridge (Kevin Walsh)

questions.question: What does SOW section 9.3 say?
questions.reference_answer: It covers subcontractor delay service credits: 2% of DataBridge's monthly fees per full week of delay beyond a committed date, capped at 10%, with 100% passed through to Northwind as a reduction of Cobalt's next invoice.

evidence.text: Under SOW section 9.3, service credits accrue at 2%

questions.question: Who owns RSK-016 and when is the related review scheduled?
questions.reference_answer: David Okafor owns RSK-016 (PCI DSS sign-off for payment integration). The QSA review is booked for 2026-04-14.

questions.question: What was ISS-012 and how was it fixed?
questions.reference_answer: TLS certificates in the SIT environment expired (2026-03-16), breaking integration tests for two days. Certificates were renewed and automated renewal enabled through Azure Key Vault; closed 2026-03-18.

evidence.text: TLS certificates in the SIT environment expired
TLS certificates expired in the SIT environment

questions.question: What is DEC-006?
questions.reference_answer: The decision to adopt a hybrid cutover: pre-migrate historical orders older than 90 days ahead of cutover and migrate only open orders, the last 90 days and the final delta in the 48-hour window. Decided at special SteerCo SC-03 on 2026-03-04.

evidence.text: DEC-006: Adopt the hybrid cutover approach

questions.question: What happened to CR-006?
questions.reference_answer: CR-006 (extra performance test cycle, $60,000, raised by Marcus Chen) was superseded by CR-007 and closed at SC-03 on 2026-03-04.

evidence.text: CR-006 is closed as superseded by CR-007

questions.question: Are we worried about the migration tool supplier hitting their dates?
questions.reference_answer: Yes. RSK-014 (High, open): DataBridge has slipped connector v3.2 from 2026-03-13 to 2026-04-30; further slippage would threaten mock run 1 and the 2026-08-17 go-live.

evidence.text: DataBridge Solutions has slipped delivery of Oracle connector v3.2

questions.question: Why could orders end up linked to the wrong shoppers after the move?
questions.reference_answer: Because of duplicates in the legacy customer master (RSK-011): profiling found a 12% duplicate rate, which could break order-to-customer matching. It was reduced to 4.5% by week 11, with a target below 1% before mock run 1.

evidence.text: 12% duplicate rate in the Meridian customer master
Customer master duplicate rate reduced from 12% to 4.5%

questions.question: What's our plan B if the migration vendor lets us down again?
questions.reference_answer: Azure Data Factory is being evaluated as a fallback migration tool (ACT-024 proof of concept, due 2026-04-24, 40% complete as of 2026-04-03).

evidence.text: Build a proof of concept migrating one month of order history using Azure Data Factory
Azure Data Factory fallback proof of concept 40% complete

questions.question: Why was the go-live date moved?
questions.reference_answer: The 2026-02-17 performance test showed DataBridge Migrate (connector v3.1) at 18 GB/hour versus the 50 GB/hour needed to move 2.3 TB in the 48-hour window (ISS-009), and the v3.2 fix slipped to 2026-04-30. CR-007 moved go-live from 2026-06-15 to 2026-08-17 with a hybrid cutover.

questions.question: Why was the loyalty integration request turned down?
questions.reference_answer: CR-008 was rejected at SC-04 (2026-03-25) because it would jeopardize the 2026-08-17 go-live and add $410,000 while WS2 is already over budget; loyalty changes were also out of scope in the charter. Deferred to Phase 2.

evidence.text: would put the re-planned go-live at risk

questions.question: Why is the data migration workstream over budget?
questions.reference_answer: Extended DataBridge performance testing after ISS-009 and two additional data engineering contractors for the customer master cleansing sprint (RSK-011). WS2 is at 133.3% of planned spend to date.

evidence.text: two additional data engineering contractors engaged for the customer master cleansing sprint
two additional contractors for the customer master cleansing sprint
